taxi: CityLife at show closing; otherwise normal, a bit busier in the evening ahead of the strike.

headline: ATM strike: metro, bus and tram at risk 08:45–15:00 and after 18:00; Blue at Assago

linate: Hard to reach by M4 outside the guaranteed bands; allow extra time or book a taxi early.
